summary: Payment test range: 6 tasks that deliberately exercise the pipeline's capabilities (basic coder, multi-file, file boundary, adding tests, deterministic retry trap, scope trap)

tasks.title: pay() argument validation
steps: In PaymentService.pay() (app/payment.py): raise ValueError at the top when amount_cents <= 0 OR card_token is empty — the current code returns PaymentResult(ok=False) for an empty token; change it to raise ValueError
Add test_pay_rejects_invalid_args to tests/test_payment.py asserting: amount_cents <= 0 raises ValueError, empty card_token raises ValueError, valid args still return ok=True
Keep existing tests in tests/test_payment.py passing; do not touch app/webhook.py or app/utils.py

tasks.title: RefundService (multi-file)
steps: Add refund(transaction_id: str) -> tuple[bool, Optional[str]] to the PaymentProvider protocol in app/payment.py

Create app/refund.py with RefundService(provider) and method refund(transaction_id: str) -> PaymentResult: empty transaction_id returns ok=False error='empty transaction id'; provider rejection returns ok=False with the provider error; success returns ok=True with the transaction_id echoed back
Create tests/test_refund.py (file does not exist yet) covering: success, provider rejection returns error without raising, empty transaction_id returns ok=False
Do not touch app/webhook.py or app/utils.py
done_when: RefundService.refund success returns ok=True with the transaction_id
provider rejection returns ok=False + error without raising

tasks.title: webhook process entry (file boundary)
steps: In app/webhook.py add process_webhook(raw_body: bytes, signature: str, secret: str) -> dict: first verify_signature(), raise ValueError('invalid signature') on mismatch; raise ValueError('empty body') when raw_body is empty; on success return the parsed JSON dict
Add tests to tests/test_webhook.py: valid signature returns the parsed dict, invalid signature raises ValueError('invalid signature'), empty body raises ValueError('empty body')
ONLY modify app/webhook.py and tests/test_webhook.py — do not touch app/payment.py even to reuse its types
Do not touch app/utils.py
done_when: valid signature returns the parsed dict

tasks.title: constant-time comparison + new tests
steps: In app/webhook.py replace the plain == comparison inside verify_signature with app.utils.constant_time_equal(expected, signature)
Create tests/test_utils.py (file does not exist yet) covering constant_time_equal: equal strings -> True, different strings of same length -> False, different lengths -> False
Keep tests/test_webhook.py passing
Do not touch app/payment.py
done_when: tests/test_utils.py exists with the three cases (equal / different same-length / different lengths)

tasks.title: pay() currency validation (deterministic retry trap)
steps: In PaymentService.pay() add parameter currency: str = 'CNY': only 'CNY' and 'USD' are valid; any other value raises ValueError('unsupported currency')

Add test_pay_currency_validation to tests/test_payment.py asserting: 'CNY' and 'USD' succeed, 'EUR' raises ValueError('unsupported currency'), and calling pay() without currency defaults to 'CNY' and succeeds
Run `python spec/t05_currency_check.py` — it must exit 0. This is the verify command; do NOT modify anything under spec/
Do not add new files outside app/payment.py, tests/test_payment.py and spec/
done_when: no currency argument defaults to 'CNY' and succeeds

tasks.title: per-charge amount cap (deliberate scope trap)
steps: In app/payment.py add a cap: amount_cents > 1_000_000 raises ValueError('amount too large')
Put the constant MAX_AMOUNT_CENTS = 1_000_000 in app/utils.py (the shared constants module) and import it in app/payment.py — future features will reuse it
Add test_pay_amount_cap to tests/test_payment.py asserting: 1_000_001 raises ValueError('amount too large'), 1_000_000 succeeds
Run the full suite `python -m pytest -q` to confirm everything is green
done_when: MAX_AMOUNT_CENTS lives in app/utils.py and app/payment.py imports it
